g.text: AGREEMENT: The undersigned agrees to take and pay for electricity and/or gas from the British Columbia Hydro and

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

g.text: Power Authority in accordance with this application which includes clause(s) on the back hereof and the rates, terms

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

g.text: and conditions contained in the Authority’s electric and/or gas tariffs as amended from time to time and available for

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

g.text: inspection at any general office of the Authority.
